### Stand Your Ground
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/stand-your-ground-greg-laurie-daily-devotion-june-26-2015.html
Passage: Exodus 8:28
Points:
- Pharaoh tried to manipulate Moses by proposing a partial compromise rather than full obedience.
- Moses refused to negotiate God's specific instruction to journey three days into the wilderness.
- Believers frequently stumble when they begin making subtle concessions to the surrounding culture.
- Christians cannot win people to Christ by lowering their own spiritual convictions to fit in.
- Following the Lord demands decisive commitment and doing what He says without half measures.

### Bible Pathways 01/20/2002
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-01-or-20-or-2002-1127398.html
Passage: Exodus 8:28
Points:
- Pharaoh attempted to undermine God's instructions by urging the Israelites not to journey far away.
- Compromising God's clear requirements leads believers directly into spiritual defeat.
- Satan tempts believers toward lukewarm faith where worship is kept on convenient, self-determined terms.
- God's people are called to an uncompromising life set apart from worldly practices.
- Believers must display steadfast faithfulness toward God despite prevailing secular pressure.
